# GP15-held-proof:1 producer fixtures

Generated by the actual authenticated HostAuthority over LocalAudio and its scoped
Authority. These additive fixtures do not replace GP15-brain:1/device:1 fixtures.
No test writes by default. Under the parent-held build procedure, explicitly run:

```
GIGPIES_UPDATE_HELD_PROOF_FIXTURES=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo +1.97.1 test --locked -j1 --features hardware-host --lib held_proof_actual_authority_fixtures_and_refusals
```

Then rerun without the variable. Runtime file reads permit compiling the generator
before generated JSON exists. Fixture equality includes the full request identity,
strict proof shape, digest and refusal reasons. Root owns generation/validation.
